table.name: Cartoon
table.purpose: Episode list for the animated series 'Batman: The Brave and the Bold' (titles, credits, air dates, production codes, and the channel each episode aired on). Each row is one episode of a cartoon series. The id is referenced by TV_series rating/viewer columns, suggesting TV_series stores per-episode ratings keyed to these episodes.

Channel.name: channel_id
Channel.description: ID of the TV channel the episode aired on; references TV_Channel.id (e.g. 701, 704, 707 are music channels). Stored as VARCHAR but contains integers.

Directed_by.name: directed_by
Directed_by.description: Name of the episode's director (e.g. Ben Jones, Brandon Vietti, Michael Chang).

Original_air_date.name: original_air_date
Original_air_date.description: Date the episode first aired, stored as text without spaces (e.g. 'December12,2008' = December 12, 2008). Dates span Nov 2008 – Feb 2009.

Production_code.name: production_code
Production_code.description: Episode production code as an integer (101–112), i.e. season 1 episodes 1–12.

Title.name: title
Title.description: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Day of the Dark Knight!').

Written_by.name: written_by
Written_by.description: Name(s) of the episode's writer (e.g. J. M. DeMatteis, Steven Melching).

id.name: episode_id
id.description: Primary key; sequential episode identifier (1–12). Referenced by TV_series rating/viewership columns, which appear to hold per-episode audience data.

table.name: TV_Channel
table.purpose: A catalog of music TV channels (mostly Italian Sky/MTV music channels), each row describing one channel's broadcast and package attributes. Referenced by TV_series and Cartoon via Channel id.

Content.name: Content
Content.description: Genre of the channel's content; all rows are 'music', so this is a music-channel catalog.

Country.name: Country
Country.description: Country of origin/broadcast of the channel (Italy, United Kingdom, Poland).

Hight_definition_TV.name: High_definition_TV
Hight_definition_TV.description: Whether the channel broadcasts in high definition ('yes'/'no').

Language.name: Language
Language.description: Broadcast language of the channel (Italian or English).

Package_Option.name: Package_Option
Package_Option.description: Pay-TV subscription package the channel belongs to (e.g. Sky Famiglia) or 'no (FTV)' meaning free-to-view.

Pay_per_view_PPV.name: Pay_per_view_PPV
Pay_per_view_PPV.description: Whether the channel is pay-per-view; all rows are 'no'.

Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.name: Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR
Pixel_aspect_ratio_PAR.description: Pixel aspect ratio of the broadcast (4:3, 16:9, or both).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; channel identifier (numeric, 700-728). Referenced by TV_series.Channel and Cartoon.Channel.

series_name.name: series_name
series_name.description: Name of the TV channel (e.g. 'Sky Music', 'MTV Hits'); unique per row despite the 'series' naming.

table.name: TV_series
table.purpose: Episode-by-episode Nielsen ratings data for a TV series (episodes aired weekly, Oct–Dec 2007, likely 'Journeyman' on NBC given episode titles and dates). Each row is one episode's broadcast and its viewership statistics.

18_49_Rating_Share.name: 18-49 rating/share
18_49_Rating_Share.description: Nielsen adults 18-49 demographic rating and share, combined as a single text value 'rating/share' (e.g. '2.4/6' = 2.4 rating, 6 share).

Air_Date.name: air date
Air_Date.description: Original broadcast date of the episode, stored as formatted text (e.g. 'December 10, 2007').

Channel.name: channel
Channel.description: Foreign key to TV_Channel.id identifying the channel/network the episode aired on. Lookup pairs show TV_Channel ids 700-728 with content labels (e.g. 701, 704, 707, 713, 719 = 'music'), so the referenced table appears to be a channel/content listing rather than a pure broadcaster list.

Episode.name: episode title
Episode.description: Title of the episode (e.g. 'Friendly Skies', 'Blowback', 'The Year of the Rabbit').

Rating.name: household rating
Rating.description: Nielsen household rating (percent of all TV households watching), values 3.0–5.8. The statistical join to Cartoon.id is spurious — a rating value is not a foreign key.

Share.name: audience share
Share.description: Nielsen audience share (percent of households watching TV at that time that watched this episode), values 5–9. The join to Cartoon.id is spurious.

Viewers_m.name: viewers (millions)
Viewers_m.description: Number of viewers in millions (4.24–9.16). The one-to-one join to Cartoon.id is spurious — a viewer count is not a foreign key.

Weekly_Rank.name: weekly rank
Weekly_Rank.description: Rank of the episode's broadcast among all network programming for that week (43–80).

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; sequential row identifier 1–12, one per episode.
